messages:
sam_engineer: noticing p95/p99 spike on /v1/embeddings since ~03:00 UTC. tracer shows lots of backend wait on kv-store. anyone else seeing this?

maria_sre: yep alerts triggered at 02:58. KV miss-rate jumped from ~3% -> ~35% and eviction ops doubled. no config rollouts in the last 24h AFAIK. :eyes:

lee_support: customer acct acme-inc reported embedding calls went from ~120ms -> 2.1s, multiple timeouts. They've escalated.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary finished for release/2026.03.15 (no traffic config changes).

ashley_runtime: grabbing logs + a quick flame. paste: ```
[03:01:02.112] kv_lookup miss prefix="user:acme:docs:"
[03:01:02.113] kv_fetch backend_wait=110ms key_count=1
[03:01:02.225] model_infer latency=1.8s (waited for kv)
```

ashley_runtime: also seeing many unique prefixes — cardinality spiking. Possible we have key-variant bug or whitespace normalization issue.

kevin_research: quick hypothesis: prefix key normalization regression introduced in gateway that stopped trimming trailing whitespace -> huge effective cardinality. Another possibility: eviction policy tilt (LRU) + bursty warmup traffic -> thrash.

sam_engineer: repro plan: run synthetic with 10k unique prefixes + a small hotset to see eviction churn. repro curl (local sim): ```bash
for i in {1..10000}; do
  curl -s -H "X-Prefix: user:acme:docs:$i " \   # note intentional trailing space to reproduce
    -d '{"input":"test"}' http://staging.internal/v1/embeddings &
done
```

lee_support: for the customer: can we ask them to send sample request headers/body including prefix values so we can confirm trailing-space hypothesis?

maria_sre: mitigation options (short):
1) hotfix ingress normalize prefixes (trim, collapse whitespace, case-normalize) and ship to prod → low-risk.
2) temporarily increase kv cache shard memory cap for embedding route until we validate.
3) adjust eviction from pure LRU -> LFU-with-decay to reduce churn for small hotsets.
4) implement warmup drip: stagger cache fills rather than blunt pre-warm which causes eviction storms.

kevin_research: +1 on normalization. Also propose add per-prefix tagging so eviction can respect tags (sticky prefixes) and avoid cross-prefix thrash. longer-term: configurable prefix-hash bucketing and bounded hotset reservoir.

ashley_runtime: created a small staging patch for normalization (trim + compress spaces) and unit tests. running canary now against internal traffic.

ops-bot: incident-tracker: created INC-582-2468 - "p99 spike due to kv prefix-cardinality thrash". severity: P2.

sam_engineer: after canary, i'll run the synthetic load above and collect p95/p99 + kv-miss-rate. if canary looks good, plan to roll normalization to prod at low traffic window.

lee_support: i'll tell Acme we have a mitigation path and will follow up with ETA. can you request sample request headers now?

maria_sre: also enabling temporary metric alert to auto-scale cache shards if eviction_rate > 5k/min to buy time, and adding a short TTL grace window to reduce cold-miss amplification.

kevin_research: note for postmortem: correlate client-side prefix inputs to miss-rate timeline, and add tests for prefix normalization across SDKs.

ashley_runtime: canary passed for 1h with normalization, kv miss-rate dropped to baseline in staging. prepping prod roll 00:30 UTC. will post rollout notes. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: thanks. will follow up with reproduction artifacts and measurement script once prod roll done.

lee_support: filing note to customer.

maria_sre: summary: root cause likely malformed prefixes (normalization bug) + eviction policy that amplifies warmup bursts -> KV thrash -> p95/p99 regressions. short-term: normalization hotfix + shard cap bump + TTL-grace. medium: eviction policy change + sticky-prefix tagging. long: prefix-bucketing + SDK tests.

ops-bot: incident-tracker: INC-582-2468 updated: status=investigating, assignees=[sam_engineer, ashley_runtime, maria_sre].
